g.text: A bullet begins the complete proof of one subgoal.Rocq checks that it finishes before the next case begins.Bullets are optional, but make structure visible and preventproofs for different subgoals from getting mixed together.In the S case, reflexivity simplifies the successor expressionand the eqb match before checking equal sides.

Mark every point where multiple subgoals are generated.Use line breaks and indentation that reveal their nesting.The source suggests roughly 80-character lines(or 120 on a wide screen), rather than either extreme.
